Webhook Events
panels.description: Received counts deliveries before their payload names a project, and ignored counts the release deliveries no project takes: unknown_repo when no project reads from the repository, unmatched_tag when none of its projects' patterns takes the tag. Only upserted follows the project filter.

panels.title: Cron Sync
panels.description: One cron run syncs every project, so cron runs ignore the project filter; releases written and deleted follow it. An incremental sync lists a project's 20 newest releases and only writes; a full one (nightly, and until a project's first succeeds) lists up to 3 pages of 100, and deletes the ones its source took down only when that listing reached its end, not the page cap.
p95 across active label combinations (per-series), not per request. Cloudflare Workers freezes performance.now() during CPU work, so durations measure I/O wait only.
panels.title: Release Source Duration
Sync Errors by Project
panels.description: Failed project syncs by error_class: rate_limited, auth, not_found, http, timeout, d1 or other. A rate limit also fails the projects after it that share it: every GitHub project, or every GitLab project on the same host. The version-project-sync-failing alert fires after 3 failed runs in 2h with the latest one failed, and resolves at the first run that succeeds.

panels.title: Skipped Tags
panels.description: Releases newer than the newest one a project's tag pattern takes, whose tags no project on its source takes. Above 0 for a day fires version-project-tags-skipped: the project probably changed its tag format.
